meta: Practice job interviews with AI: many beginners answer vaguely just because they've never practiced out loud.

muc.title: Vague answers
muc.text: Many beginners answer interview questions very vaguely, simply because they've never practiced saying them out loud.

muc.title: Give AI the role
muc.text: Ask AI to play the recruiter for the exact role you're applying for, asking one question per turn.

muc.title: Tell a real situation
muc.text: When you answer, tell a real situation: the context, what you did and the result. Turn on voice mode to practice speaking.

muc.title: Score every answer
muc.text: At the end, ask AI to score each answer, point out what's still vague, and suggest what you could ask the recruiter back.

muc.title: Fifteen minutes of practice
muc.text: Practice five interview questions with AI for fifteen minutes and note your weakest answer.
